options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: controlled_end_delay_time
options.description: Specifies the amount of time (in seconds) that is allowed to complete the controlled subsystem end operation. If this amount of time is exceeded and the end operation is not complete, any jobs still being processed in the subsystem are ended immediately. If the value is greater than 99999, C(*NOLIMIT) will be used in ENDSBS command DELAY parameter.

options.name: end_subsystem_option
options.description: Specifies the options to take when ending the active subsystems.

options.name: how_to_end
options.description: Specifies whether jobs in the subsystem are ended in a controlled manner or immediately.

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), output the available job log even the rc is 0(success).

options.name: parameters
options.description: The parameters that ENDSBS command will take. Other than the options above, all other parameters need to be specified here. The default values of parameters for ENDSBS will be taken if not specified.

options.name: subsystem
options.description: The name of the subsystem description.
